tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by four different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
American Express is cutting 5% of its workforce with a $336M charge, according to Wealth Professional Confirmed, as the payments giant aims to become leaner and more artificial intelligence ready.
GitHub has started enabling unconfigured Copilot features under a new default policy, Reported by MIXED Reality News.
OpenAI says its GPT-5.6 Sol model helped find PHP2Shell flaws, Reported by TechRound. Patches were released early, but the workload on open-source maintainers continues to grow.
A class action lawsuit accuses OpenAI of unlawfully extracting children's data, Reported by Top Class Actions.
Chef Altman warns that advanced artificial intelligence cannot be contained permanently, Reported by The Decoder. He urges new approaches to alignment and security models.
Free every hour.
